slides.title: An easier ATAK
slides.html: ATAK can do almost anything, but it is built for specialists. OpenDefence Main puts marking, sending and reading reports one thumb away.

slides.title: Plugins join in
slides.html: Other OpenDefence plugins, such as Drones and Voice, add their buttons to the thumb bar. Your requests to Drones and their answers show in the same Inbox.

slides.title: Tap an enemy mark
slides.html: Tap an enemy mark, such as this Anti-armour, then the target button on the ring around it. It is the crosshair at the lower left.

slides.title: Ask from the map
slides.html: Ask Drones for a Strike or Recon on an enemy mark, straight from the map. The answer comes to your Inbox.

slides.title: One way of working, shared
slides.html: Learn Markers, Send to… and the Inbox once. Plugins that build on them, such as Drones, use them the same way.

slides.title: A template for every plugin
slides.html: Every OpenDefence plugin is built and checked the same way, and TAK.gov signs it. New plugins, such as Fires and Logistics, will be made the same way.

slides.title: Built for military use
slides.html: Markers draws APP-6D and MIL-STD-2525D symbols and sends standard CoT that any TAK client reads. Your admins set the usual types, like these enemy favourites, and your unit's ORBAT for the whole operation.
